name: keel-marketplace
description: keel: an enforced spec and acceptance-criteria workflow where hooks and a CLI decide the rules rather than the model remembering them. Kotlin/Spring and TypeScript React are built in; other stacks install from keel-stacks.

plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Enforced spec and acceptance-criteria workflow with pluggable stacks: RED/GREEN loops, guarded commits, coverage gate, review and ship blueprint.

plugins.name: keel-stacks
plugins.description: Stack packs for keel: Symfony (PHP) and plain-JavaScript React. Install with `keel packs add` as well, so keel itself can read them.
